rows.name: Sourcetree

rows.name: mcp-docgen
rows.reason: CLI generates Markdown/HTML/JSON from local MCP projects. Implementation, transport coverage, output quality and pre-cutoff availability unverified; it is not a complete mixed-source site generator.

rows.name: MkDocs with MkDoxy, mkdocs-openapi, and an MCP Markdown export
rows.reason: MkDocs combines MkDoxy/Doxygen XML, mkdocs-openapi and MCP Markdown export. Pipeline untested; alpha mkdocs-openapi supports local OpenAPI 3.x and targets Material. MCP export requires a separate build step.

rows.name: MCP Discovery
rows.reason: MCP Discovery exports server capabilities to Markdown/HTML for incorporation into a documentation site. It does not assemble OpenAPI/Doxygen alone; server access and regeneration after capability changes are required.
